scripts.title: OPEN SOURCE DUNGEON HEROES KILL AURA
scripts.script:
local replicated_storage = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
local workspace = cloneref(game:GetService("Workspace"))

local mobsenemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")

getgenv().settings = {
    enabled = true,
    delay = 0.25 
}

if settings.enabled then
    repeat
        local mobs = {}
        for _, v in next, mobsenemies:GetChildren() do
            table.insert(mobs, v)
        end
        replicated_storage:WaitForChild("Systems"):WaitForChild("Combat"):WaitForChild("PlayerAttack"):FireServer(mobs)
        task.wait(settings.delay)
    until not settings.enabled
end

UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then

                PlayerButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                SelectedPlayer = player
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Update scroll size
    task.wait(0.1)
    PlayerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
end

RefreshPlayerList()

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(RefreshPlayerList)

TeleportButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            root.CFrame = SelectedPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(2, 0, 2)
        end
    end
end)
